More you could add to Reports

Ideas for later — not built yet, just food for thought
  • Revenue & payout trends — total revenue and average order value over the same weekly/monthly/yearly buckets, per listing.
  • Views → bookings conversion — you already track view_count per listing; plot it against bookings to see which listings convert best.
  • Booking lead time — how far in advance customers book (event_date − created_at), to spot last-minute vs. planned demand.
  • Seasonality heatmap — a calendar heatmap of which months/weekdays get the most events booked.
  • Cancellation reasons breakdown — a pie of cancellation_reason / refund type to see why bookings fall through.
  • Response time — average time from a pending booking landing to your approve/decline action.
  • Repeat customers — % of bookings from a customer email/phone seen before.
  • Export — a "Download CSV / PDF" button on this page for offline reporting.
